candidates.title: Infinite-LLM: Efficient LLM Service for Long Context with DistAttention and Distributed KVCache
candidates.reason: attention layerを他の推論処理から分離し、distributed KV cacheとpooled GPU memoryで長contextをelasticに処理。32 A100で1.35-3.4x throughput改善、最大2000K context評価を報告し、attention disaggregation lineageの重要な未収録候補。

candidates.title: InferScale: GPU-Native KV Injection for Personalized LLM Serving
candidates.reason: retrieved memory factのKVを事前計算しGPU上でsemantic retrieval後にvLLM paged cacheへ直接inject。k=50でTTFT 72-79%削減、concurrent loadでthroughput 3.7-4.5xを報告し、personalized/agent memory servingとKV reuseの接点として強い。

candidates.title: BucketServe: Bucket-Based Dynamic Batching for Smart and Efficient LLM Inference Serving
candidates.reason: sequence lengthでhomogeneous bucketを作り、adaptive split/mergeとpriority schedulingでpadding・OOM・SLOを同時に扱うdynamic batching system。throughput最大3.58x、SLO 80%でDistServe比1.93x loadを報告。

candidates.title: CaraServe: CPU-Assisted and Rank-Aware LoRA Serving for Generative LLM Inference
candidates.reason: LoRA adapter servingでCPU-assisted execution、rank-aware scheduling、custom CUDA operatorsを用いてcold adapter loadingとheterogeneous rankを扱う。multi-adapter serving lineageの比較対象としてChameleon等の前史を補完する。

candidates.title: Scaling Graph Chain-of-Thought Reasoning: A Multi-Agent Framework with Efficient LLM Serving
candidates.reason: multi-agent Graph-CoTとgraph-specific KV management、priority eviction、pipelined executionをco-designし、latency 90.3%削減・throughput最大15.1xを報告。application-specificだがagent workflow servingのsystem実装として隣接価値がある。

discovery_stats.axis: serving engine・dynamic batching・distributed KV/attention・adapter/personalized serving
discovery_stats.query_summary: continuous batching、GPU memory allocator、serving engine/kernel、CUDA graph、KV injectionへ検索窓を移動。vAttention、MELL、AlignedServe、FastDecode、Helix、vLLM/PagedAttention等をidentity snapshotで評価前に除外し、provider検索窓終了時に残った5件を評価して採用した。
